description: Synthetic second reading, made from the real tape in fixtures/published-2026-11-11-0808 (every time moved 1800 s later): the finalized header is block 3457487 again, the height the log holds, but under another hash. It is read on top of a log holding that real reading. The two reads of the upgrade watch at the finalized head, right after its runtime version, are synthetic too: state_getStorage of System.LastRuntimeUpgrade answers the record research/2026-11-12-runtime-upgrade/results.json gives at boundary.0.last_runtime_upgrade.hex (tzkv-runtime 1014014), and of System.AuthorizedUpgrade answers null, as authorization.authorized_upgrade_at.0.value gives; upgrade_answers names both.
